about:
# Ventilla

Bring <cg>live radio</c> to your Geometry Dash experience!

<cl>Ventilla</c> replaces the default main menu music with a **non-profit** live radio station made for the Geometry Dash community.

Radio URL: [radio.5infin.es](https://radio.5infin.es) 

### Copyright Notice for Artists and Content Creators

<cy>For Songwriters:</c> If you're an artist and wish for your music to be removed from this radio station, please contact us immediately at <cj>joseii@5infin.es</c> or send a DM to <cj>@Analogias_Esp</c> on X to resolve the issue in no time.

<cy>For Content Creators:</c> Be careful using this mod while recording or streaming, we cannot fully confirm the suitability of the songs for your content.
#
*Ventilla - 5inFin | United by events*
